title.en: An Act Granting to the Municipality of Pandan, Province of Antique, a Franchise to Install, Operate and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power System.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to the municipality of Pandan, Province of Antique, for a period of fifty
years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an
electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and
power, for sale within the limits of the said municipality of Pandan, Province of Antique, Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1932.
